mapping_warning: S1 and S2 run opposite to the dataset's A and B. S1 is aKw9UnnjRq5scbeeGI7Z, which make_audio.py assigns to speaker B; S2 is s3TPKV1kjDlVtZbl4Ksh, which it assigns to speaker A.
